releases.notes: - Apollo330P and Apollo510L RTM.
- Official support for Apollo330P and Apollo510L using product names.
- Support for Apollo330P and Apollo510L.
- Suppress multiple SVD errors/warnings from SVDConv.
- Release To Market support for Apollo510 devices, AP510NFA-CBR and AP510NFA-CCR.
- Updated Support for Apollo4 Lite devices AMAP42KL-KBR and AMA4B2KL-KBR.
- Support for Apollo4 Plus and Apollo4 Blue Plus devices including AMAP42KK-KBR and AMA4B2KP-KBR. - New secure URL site for packs downloads.
- Support for Apollo4 secure bootloader/AMAP42KK-KBR. - Add support for AMAP42KK-KCR and AMA4B2KK-KBR (SiP). - Remove support for Apollo4 Rev A (use Pack v1.2.8 for these devices).
- Support for Apollo4 secure bootloader and AMAP42KK-KBR. - Still supports nbl and sblA.
- Support for Apollo4nbl (non-bootloader) AMAP42KK-KBR-nbl, AMAP42KK-KBR-sblA.
- Support for Apollo3 Blue Plus.
- Full support for Apollo3 Blue.

- Update device names to correspond to their official part numbers. - Update both Apollo and Apollo2 SVD files, particularly update vector table in Apollo2.svd. Also make sure svd files are schema compliant.
Ambiq Micro Apollo Device Family Keil Pack supporting the Apollo device. - Adds additional Apollo2 support.
- Update the Apollo2.svd file.
- Initial release of the Keil Pack for the Ambiq Micro Apollo2 Device supporting the FPGA emulator.
> - Rename the devices using underscores per Keil requirements. - Updates the PDSC file with other minor corrections suggested by the Keil team.
- Update of the Apollo.svd file.
- Release Keil Pack containing support for the Ambiq Micro the Apollo device.
- Beta Keil Pack containing support for the Ambiq Micro Apollo device.
Added support for Arm Cortex-M85 processor based devices. Added support for Arm China Star-MC1 processor based devices. Updated documentation appearance.
Added clock frequency to internal Event Recorder Initialization message.
Added Event Recorder logging via Semihosting.
Updated SCVD examples to Arm Compiler 6. Added Dcore Cortex-M55 to list of supported processors. Updated Event Recorder documentation describing the concept of heart beat events.

Added ARMV81MML to list of supported processors. Updated EventRecorder.scvd: - using level 'Detail' for start/stop A event group. - adding prefix attribute to enable linking the event property to the doxygen documentation.
Event Recorder examples - reset in simulation restarts CYCCNT. Updated documentation clarifying that the Event Recorder RAM location must not overlap with RAM area used for Flash Programming.
Added Cortex-M35P device support Event Recorder: - extended SCVD file format with state information - changed protocol version to 1.1 - added example projects for Cortex-M0 and state information

Added Cortex-M1 to the list of support processors Event Recorder: - added CMSIS RTOS2 as Time Stamp Source - extended Time Stamp Timer interface - added EventRecorderClockUpdate function - enhanced MISRA Compliance - improved robustness Fixed version numbers Updated documentation

Added Event Statistics feature to Event Recorder: - added EventStart and EventStop events to Event Recorder component. - added Example demonstrating Event Statistic. - updated EventRecorder.scvd file adding 'Event Statistics' group and 'Start/Stop' event descriptions. - updated Event Recorder documentation for Event Statistics.
